geometry: all native columns; conservative exact-max rejection hierarchy
crop_policy: exposed canonical faces only; no crop caps; unbounded downward solid columns
tint: 32m/4m coherent paint plus cell hash grain fading over 12..40m from eye to native cell center; f64 distance, f32 paint

lighting.implementation: independent CPU f64 face lighting; canonical material palette
lighting.settings_apply_to: regional profile only; legacy retains fixed normalized [-0.5,0.8,-0.3] sun and original hemisphere

sampling: deterministic jittered square stratification SplitMix64; box pixel filter; f64 linear accumulation
depth: mean hit distance in meters; NaN on miss
miss_policy: sky on all misses; missed rays leaving the finite native footprint are incomplete oracle coverage, never a geometry pass
